'''Michael Frank Hallett''' is a British philosopher and John Frothingham Professor of Logic and Metaphysics at [[McGill University]].
He is known for his works on [[set theory]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Moore |first1=Gregory H. |title=Michael Hallett. Cantorian set theory and limitation of size. Oxford logic guidelines, no. 10. Clarendon Press, Oxford University Press, Oxford and New York1984, xxiii + 343 pp. |journal=The Journal of Symbolic Logic |date=June 1987 |volume=52 |issue=2 |pages=568–570 |doi=10.2307/2274416 |language=en |issn=0022-4812}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Dauben |first1=Joseph W. |author-link=Joseph Dauben |title=Review of Cantorian Set Theory and Limitation of Size |journal=The British Journal for the Philosophy of Science |date=1988 |volume=39 |issue=4 |pages=541–550 |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/687440 |issn=0007-0882}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Clark |first1=Peter |title=Review of Cantorian Set Theory and Limitation of Size. |journal=Mind |date=1986 |volume=95 |issue=380 |pages=523–528 |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/2254162 |issn=0026-4423}}</ref>
